notes.title: Update #3: Oculus
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/2e30873ba7fa5b68cc94972f437da2c84a870c6c.png

Just released support for Oculus + Touch Controllers. ːsteamhappyː

This is just first stage of integration. We are still using Valve's OpenVR for Oculus HMD, but it's fully playable now.
Later we plan to fully integrate Oculus SDK for native support.

In the next update we plan to add visual representation of Oculus Touch controllers, now in-game it looks the same as with Vive's.
We have made 2 concept arts for controllers, will be great to get opinion.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/589e42c332a76f68394457b4ec6abe48b8e94cd7.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/b448a573c155f4b741288c5f0425bea64c6c7c35.png

We find out that for some players - height may not work correctly, you can try to install beta patch. 
NOT RECOMMENDED TO INSTALL FOR PLAYERS WHO HAS CORRECT HEIGHT IN GAME.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdJhpYPU4Js8944/giphy.gif

notes.title: Update #2: Level 4
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/9da57530f8c688a9c61e0d2a574d0427e762416f.png
Hey, we just released our new update for RedCubeVR game :) sorry to keep you waiting, had some works with fixing bugs.

Version v0.2 Release notes:

Fixes and small features:
-New music in Level 1
-Optimized texture resolutions in previous levels - for better quality and performance
-Added glowing trail to sword
-Fixed few steam achievements
-Fixed "Shield" bonus bug - few users had problems with shooting while shield is activated.
-Fixed "Slowdown" bonus - when we die, it resets now properly.

Main update features:
-Added new Level 4 - it is a completely new in-game location. The main features are - openness and large size.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/99548dfb5e81c3a95025d8898ab17aee246757b3.png

https://media.giphy.com/media/3oKIPcIcKPdpvvKldC/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGjK9wECizu1DPi/giphy.gif

-Added new enemy: "Grenade".
It flies like projectile and have big explosion force.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/01e52c629d51616a793087708ac6fa79f065ff17.png

https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGHRrM3IpknTihy/giphy.gif

-Added new weapon: "Laser".
Fast, powerful, have good attack distance, but needs accuracy.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/3878eea95e59c3b7173b47e44e57fb75d68d35ff.png

https://media.giphy.com/media/3oKIPm4O8NTbZtsQ6I/giphy.gif

-New game mechanics: Enemy portals and swinging pendulums:

https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGrrNuHmar5d6ww/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/3oKIPcWZSwxvCFwses/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGwkxZY4u4tyLza/giphy.gif
